claim.claim-text: 1. A stilling vessel (12) for connecting to a submerged combustion melter (10) for managing the flow of foamy molten glass produced in the submerged combustion melter (10), the stilling vessel (12) including a stilling tank (70) and a feeding spout (72), the stilling tank (70) having a housing (74) that defines a stilling chamber (82), an inlet (86), and an outlet (88), and the feeding spout (72) being appended to the stilling tank (70) so as to cover the outlet (88) of the stilling tank (70), wherein the feeding spout (72) holds a transfer pool of molten glass (114) and is configured to deliver a molten glass feed (22) from the transfer pool at a controlled rate to a downstream component (24).

2. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 1, wherein the feeding spout (72) is configured to deliver the molten glass feed (22) from the transfer pool at a controlled rate to a glass finer (132) being the downstream component (24).
3. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 1 or 2, wherein the feeding spout (72) defines a spout chamber (112) that communicates with the stilling chamber (82).

4. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in any of the preceding claims, wherein the feeding spout (72) having a spout bowl (98) and an orifice plate (100) defining at least one orifice (118) for delivering the molten glass feed (22) out of the feeding spout (72).

5. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in any of the preceding claims, wherein the molten glass feed (22) delivered from the feeding spout (72) is drawn from the transfer pool of molten glass (114) and delivered through an orifice plate (100) at a controlled rate as governed by a controlled reciprocating movement of a reciprocal plunger (104).
6. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in any of the preceding claims, wherein the housing (74) of the stilling tank (70) is formed of a refractory material that is not fluidly cooled.

7. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in any of the preceding claims, wherein the stilling tank (70) includes one or more non-submerged burners (90) aimed to discharge combustion products (92) into the stilling chamber (82).

8. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 7, wherein the unrefined foamy molten glass received from the submerged combustion melter (10) is held within the stilling chamber (82) as an intermediate pool of molten glass (84) and some of the non-submerged burners (90) impinge the intermediate pool of molten glass with their combustion products to reduce an amount of foam that ascends to the top surface of the pool of molten glass (84).
9. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 7 or 8,

wherein the one or more non-submerged burners (90) include a plurality of roof burners (90b) mounted in a roof (78) of the housing (74) of the stilling tank (70), wherein the plurality of roof burners (90b) are preferably spaced apart across the roof (78) from one side wall (80c) of the housing (74) to an opposed side wall (80d) of the housing (74).

10. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 9, wherein the roof burners (90b) are pivotably or fixedly mounted within a burner block and are high-velocity burners whose combustion products (92b) are aimed to directly impinge the intermediate pool of molten glass (84).
11. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in claim 10, wherein the high velocity roof burners (90b) have a minimum gas velocity of 914 m (3000 feet) per second at an exit of the burners.

12. The stilling vessel (12) set forth in any of claims 7 to 11, wherein the one or more non-submerged burners (90) include a plurality of sidewall burners (90a) mounted in an upstanding wall (80) of the housing (74) of the stilling tank (70).
13. A system for producing glass, the system comprising:

14. The system set forth in claim 13, wherein the stilling vessel (12) is connected to the submerged combustion melter (10) with both structures (10, 12) being mechanically attached and supported on a common frame so that the two structures (10, 12) rock and vibrate in unison in response to sloshing and generally turbulent nature of the glass melt (16), wherein the stilling vessel (12) receives the unrefined foamy molten glass (18) discharged from the submerged combustion melter (10) having a fluctuating flow rate, and delivers a molten glass feed (22) at a controlled flow rate to a downstream component (24).
15. The system set forth in claim 14,

wherein the downstream component (24) to which the molten glass feed (22) is supplied is a glass finer (132), and wherein the system comprises the finer (132) that includes: a housing (134) defining a fining chamber (136) and an inlet opening (140) defined in one end of the housing (134) and an outlet opening (142) defined in an opposite end of the housing (134), and wherein a molten glass bath (138) is held within the fining chamber (136) and flows from the inlet opening (140) to the outlet opening (142); and a plurality of non-submerged burners (144) that are mounted in the housing (134) of the finer (132) above the molten glass bath (138) and combust a mixture of fuel and oxidant, wherein the combustion products emitted from the burners (144) transfer heat to the molten glass bath (138) to help promote the ascension and bursting of entrained gas bubbles and dissolved gases,

wherein in operation, the molten glass feed (22) is received into the fining chamber (136) through the inlet opening (140) and combines with the molten glass bath (138) contained in the fining chamber (136) and wherein the molten glass bath (138) in turn supplies refined molten glass (146) from the outlet opening (142) of the housing (134).
